title: Part One: The Hill Country and the Partition

sections.brief: The 1947 plan: what each state got, by land and population; ownership; the 'desert' and the fertile valleys, both given; the hill country assigned to the Arab state. Figures: comparison; stats.
The war in and around the hills: Plan D, Deir Yassin, Latrun, Lydda and Ramle, Jerusalem divided; Abdullah's understanding with the Zionist leadership. Figure: timeline.
The 1949 armistice with Jordan, the Green Line, Wadi Ara; the refugees in the West Bank; what was left of the Arab state. Figure: flow from plan to line.
